Wizard Instant (PartTheMistveil). '**Amp 1**

If you have no cards in hand, draw a card.' Amp is NOT consumed from the card DB keywords field by the engine (high_voltage_blue.json comment verifies this) — it MUST be authored in JSON. The AMP effect (effect_types.py:1894-1899) calls effect_amp -> canonical amp() (effect_keywords.py:2853-2877, CR 8.5.47): next arcane damage this turn deals +1, stored in player.class_counters['amp']. The conditional draw uses CONDITIONAL_EFFECT (effect_types.py:3739-3766) with 'when' (NOT 'conditions' — the loader pops 'conditions' into an effect-level gate that would skip the whole branch). HAND_SIZE_EQ amount 0 (condition_types.py:1119-1144) tests for exactly empty hand. DRAW amount 1 defaults to SELF. Release note: 'You will draw a card if you have no cards in hand when this card resolves.' The condition is evaluated at resolution (interpreter runs ability effects at resolution), matching the note.
